violations.text: Cream, eggs and sausage were observed held at 43-48 degrees Fahrenheit. Time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food must be held at 41 degrees Fahrenheit or below except during preparation, cooking, or cooling. Foods were assessed and placed into other refrigeration and freezer during time of inspection. Ambient of walk-in cooler was observed at ranging temperatures of 44-47 degrees Fahrenheit. Service call is in place. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 05/27/2026

Air circulating fan at evaporator in walk-in cooler (on right side) was observed not circulating. Condensate was also observed leaking. Equipment to be in good repair. Service call is in place. New Violation. Correct By: 05/27/2026
Caulking at the handwashing sinks were observed in poor repair, causing debris accumulation. New Violation. Correct By: 06/10/2026
Sanitizer bucket was observed in the hand-washing sink. A hand-washing sink must not be used for purposes other than hand washing. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 11/04/2024
The caulking located in the hand-sink area was not in good repair. Caulking must be maintained in good repair. New Violation. Correct By: 12/04/2024
The walk-in freezer was observed with an accumulation of ice. Establishment is to run defrost on unit. New Violation. Correct By: 11/18/2024
